links.comparator_used: Single initial (zero-shot) prompt without iterative refinement
links.outcome: Specificity for clinically relevant (major/moderate) ASM drug-drug interactions, assessed in false positive cases
links.effect: ChatGPT specificity 0.358 with single prompt vs 0.77 after iterative prompting; DeepSeek 0.200 vs 0.42
links.tradeoff: Post hoc analysis run exclusively on false positive cases, so effects on sensitivity and true positives were not assessed. DeepSeek specificity stayed low even after iteration.
links.quote: Iterative prompting substantially improved specificity for ChatGPT (0.77) and DeepSeek (0.42), correcting many false positive classifications.
